description: Central, climate regulator hub - aggregates the heating or cooling requirements from zonal climate regulators and decides which should be enabled.

inputs.description: Input for the temperature deviation output of a zonal climate controller - zone 1

inputs.name: Temperature deviation, zone 4
inputs.description: Input for the temperature deviation output of a zonal climate controller - zone 4

config.name: Activation threshold - single
config.description: Threshold of the single input temperature deviation below which the block stays idle. After activation the block aims to zero all the temp. deviations.

config.name: Activation threshold - sum
config.description: Threshold of the sum of all temperature deviation inputs below which the block stays idle. After activation the block aims to zero all the temp. deviations.
